# Bulletin: AI News Reader

RSS Feed Summary & Read Later

Free · In‑App Purchases

Share

iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision, Apple TV, Apple Watch

Now redesigned for iPad and Mac with native sidebars, customizable article swipes, and quick card-style switching. Stay informed without the noise. Bulletin uses AI to summarize articles from your RSS feeds, so you can read more in less time, across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. AI-POWERED NEWS READING ――― • Instant AI summaries of any article. Understand the key points without reading the full text • Smart title improvements that cut through clickbait • Streaming AI responses for faster results YOUR NEWS, YOUR WAY ――― • Add custom RSS feeds from any blog or news site • Pre-configured categories like News, Technology, Sports, Entertainment, Business, Fashion, Design, and Food • Organize feeds into custom categories • Import OPML files from other RSS readers READ LATER ――― • Save any article with one tap to read when you're ready • Build a personalized reading list from all your feeds • Auto-remove articles after reading, or keep them forever • Syncs across all your devices with iCloud ACROSS EVERY APPLE DEVICE ――― • iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud sync • Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets • Live Activities bring headlines to your Dynamic Island CLEAN & PRIVATE ――― • Automatically strips tracking parameters from article URLs • No ads, no algorithms. You choose your sources • Your reading habits stay on your device PREMIUM EXPERIENCE ――― • Dark mode with Extra Dark option for OLED screens • Customizable accent colors • Adjustable text sizes and serif/sans-serif font options • 9 alternate app icons to personalize your home screen Try Bulletin free. AI summaries, clean reading, and your news, your way. --- Terms of Service: https://www.pixelfolio.app/terms.html Privacy Policy: https://www.pixelfolio.app/privacy.html

## What’s New

Bulletin 2.2 includes: • A redesigned iPad and Mac experience with native sidebars • Customizable swipe actions in either direction • Quick card-style switching from your feed • Selectable Smart Summary text • New Design and Food starter categories for new users • Optional unread article counts • Saved articles kept exclusively in Read Later This release also improves iCloud Sync, feed loading, and translation, with fixes throughout the app.
